AtModel.description:
Where an `insert` writes: a point, or a piece of text to hang off.

The point is the BASELINE ORIGIN of the first line written -- where the bottom left
of the first glyph sits, not the top left of a text box. That is how every
coordinate in this engine is expressed (a span's `origin`, `/v1/text`'s span
geometry), so the x/y of a span read out of a document can be used here unchanged;
and it is the one of the two that does not move when `fit` shrinks the size.

y.description: Baseline origin y: where the first line sits, measured from the page's TOP edge (PDF viewer convention, as every bbox and span origin in this API). A fraction of the page height when units='fraction'.

info.description:
Edit text inside existing PDFs: replace, delete, redact, insert and fill forms, keeping the original fonts and layout, with every change verified before it is returned.

**Source.** The editing engine is free software under the AGPL-3.0; its complete source is served to API users at `GET /source` (a tar.gz of the engine package, its Dockerfile and the licence).

## Error codes

Every error is `{"error": {"code", "message", "hint"}}` with one of these codes; `X-Request-Id` is on every response.

| `error.code` | HTTP | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `invalid_request` | 400 | The request is malformed, an edit is impossible as written, or an Idempotency-Key was reused with a different body. |
| `unauthorized` | 401 | No key, an unknown key, or a revoked key. |
| `quota_exceeded` | 402 | The month's allowance and any credit-pack pages are used up; buy a pack or upgrade on the account page. |
| `forbidden_watermark_off` | 403 | options.watermark "off" on a flagged document needs a plan that allows it and accepted terms. |
| `not_found` | 404 | No such file, job or route for this account. |
| `conflict` | 409 | A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running; wait and re-poll, do not start another. |
| `too_large` | 413 | The document exceeds the plan's size or page limit. |
| `document_encrypted` | 422 | The PDF is encrypted and no (or a wrong) password was given. |
| `document_unsupported` | 422 | The file is not a PDF the engine can open (damaged, a portfolio, a non-PDF). |
| `signed_document` | 422 | The document carries a digital signature; pass options.break_signature true to edit it anyway. |
| `edit_failed` | 422 | Every requested edit failed verification and was rolled back; see failed[] for the reasons. |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | Over the plan's requests-per-minute, or the service is busy; honour Retry-After. |
| `engine_error` | 500 | The engine crashed on this document; retry once, then report the X-Request-Id. |
| `upstream_error` | 502 | source.url (or records_url) could not be fetched. |
| `engine_timeout` | 504 | The synchronous run did not finish in time; send it again with options.async true. |

## Headers

`Idempotency-Key` on `POST /v1/edit` and `POST /v1/batch` makes retries safe. Rate-limited operations return `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset`; a `429` adds `Retry-After`.

## Webhooks

Set `options.webhook_url` on an edit or a batch and the gateway POSTs the job's result body (plus `event` and `job_id`) to that URL when the job finishes, signed with `X-Signature` (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with your account's webhook secret from `GET /v1/limits`'s account tooling or the CLI), retrying at 1, 5 and 30 minutes on a non-2xx.

post.description: Apply one or more edits (replace, delete, redact, insert, form fill) to a document and get the edited PDF back with every change verified. Send the document as a multipart upload (`file`) with `edits` as a JSON string, or as JSON with `source.url` or a `source.file_id` from an earlier upload. Small documents answer `200` with the result at once; larger ones (over the plan's sync page limit) and any request with `options.async` true answer `202` with a `job_id` to poll at `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}` (or set `options.webhook_url` to be called when it finishes). Add `Accept: application/pdf` to receive the edited file itself instead of JSON. Each entry in `changes` says which font was written (`font_source`, `font_used`), whether the pixel check passed (`verified`, `collateral_pixels`) and links a before/after preview; `unmatched` and `failed` list what did not happen and why.
